Mechanism: unique-mechanism-graph
How: each seat keeps one public graph of its own voyage, and a second key must grow a new garden instead of cloning that path.
Cost: an extra identity posts a bond of 3 payouts, and a copied path forfeits the bond when the two graphs match.
Check: peers recompute both graphs from the zenith of the trail, so a clone folds back onto the first seat.
